hints.title: Greedy Assignment
hints.text: At cell row i and column j, assign the maximum value possible without exceeding remaining row or column sum.

hints.title: Take the Minimum
hints.text: Set cell value to minimum of remaining row sum and column sum.

hints.title: Deduct and Advance
hints.text: Deduct the assigned value from both sums and move forward through the matrix.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Solving via linear equation systems is slow and overcomplicated for non-negative bounding.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct greedy assignment takes optimal O(m * n) time and storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that min(rowSum[i], colSum[j]) preserves non-negativity across all remaining cells.
